import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from pyscf import gto, dft
smi='C1C2CC3N=COC2C13'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, randomSeed=42, useRandomCoords=True)
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m)
conf=m.GetConformer()
atom=[]
for i,a in enumerate(m.GetAtoms()):
    p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
    atom.append([a.GetSymbol(), (p.x,p.y,p.z)])
print('molecule: C7H9NO; atoms:',len(atom))
mol=gto.M(atom=atom, basis='def2-svp', charge=0, spin=0, unit='Angstrom', verbose=0)
calc=dft.RKS(mol)
calc.xc='b3lyp'
calc.conv_tol=1e-9
calc.max_cycle=100
energy=calc.kernel()
moe=np.asarray(calc.mo_energy)
occ=np.asarray(calc.mo_occ)
occ_idx=np.where(occ>0)[0]
vir_idx=np.where(occ==0)[0]
h=moe[occ_idx[-1]]
l=moe[vir_idx[0]]
print('converged:',calc.converged)
print('total_energy_Ha:',f'{energy:.12f}')
print('HOMO_Ha:',f'{h:.12f}')
print('LUMO_Ha:',f'{l:.12f}')
print('gap_Ha:',f'{l-h:.12f}')
print('gap_eV:',f'{(l-h)*27.211386245988:.6f}')
print('nocc:',len(occ_idx),'nmo:',len(moe))
